svg.text: KoFI subscriptions · test version with aggregates

The class wall with aggregates, checked against the seminar 4 code (Kofi.Domain/Subscriptions/Subscription.cs). A command with one event: the event is stuck to the command, the aggregate on top across the seam.
One command, one database transaction, three places: the Subscription aggregate
(PrepareDelivery: the delivery is ready, the next one is scheduled), Order (charge,
paid order) and Product (stock check and reservation). The card charge is outside
the database: a rollback cannot undo it.
In the seminar 4 code Order and Product are still plain KoFI data models; they become aggregates in seminar 5.
Until the customer decides, the delivery stays due
and the daily run retries it; an incomplete order is never sent.
"(already in KoFI)": contact point with existing code
